system.description:
As an action, attempt to cast a number of targets equal to your Arcane Might within 10 yards into an illusionary nightmare. Make a Genjutsu roll which they may contest with a pure Will roll. On a win, characters of equal Arcane Might to you are Frightened. Should you score a critical win, characters of equal Arcane Might are Terrified. Characters of greater Arcane Might count their level of success as one greater, only becoming Frightened should you score a critical win. Characters of lesser Arcane Might who you win this test against are either Terrified or rendered completely unable to move. In all cases this effect lasts for a minute but may be maintained for longer by paying the cost of this ability again.

If the target is Stressed they automatically fail their save against this ability. Creatures that have successfully resisted this ability are immune to it until their next rest.
